description: Analyze a recorded trace using the Chrome DevTools trace engine. List insight sets, then inspect a named insight such as LCPBreakdown, DocumentLatency, RenderBlocking or CLSCulprits. Accepts traceId or saved .json/.json.gz filePath.

filePath.description: Saved raw trace; works after server restart

insightSetId.description: ID from the trace's available insight sets

maxItems.description: Maximum items in nested insight collections

traceId.description: ID returned when stopping a trace
